notes.title: Cyber Paradise Debuts a Medieval Bonus Area at London Games Festival (3-4 April)
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

🎉 We're proud to announce that
Cyber Paradise has been officially selected for London Games Festival (LGF)!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44328944/076383a66c079d8201f2c6161660863c9be6cf0e.png

Exhibition details at the end!

To celebrate, we're debuting a new Robin Hood's Medieval England area in the demo at the festival, created in collaboration with Red Rebellion.

Cyber Paradise Special Edition Demo – Addition of a Robin Hood’s Medieval England-Themed Area

This content is brought to you with the historically researched background of Red Rebellion, a narrative adventure game set in medieval England where female Robin Hood and Red Riding Hood team up to save their town. Experience the intriguing history of medieval England in this cyberpunk simulation!

Example scene:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44328944/ba5a351d383be69158778685620b161961dc837e.png
▲The Red Rebellion team spent years researching the setting, even consulting a British medievalist professor and historian to ensure historical accuracy. This dog-powered rotisserie is one of the fun facts they provided for the crossover.

More about Red Rebellion:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2114160/Red_Rebellion/

London Games Festival – Exhibition Details
Venue: New Game Plus, London Museum Spaces, 150 London Wall, EC2Y 5HN
Date: 3rd- 4th April, 2025, 10 am - 6 pm

Get your ticket here: tickets.games.london

Note: Unfortunately, Cyber Paradise will be exhibited without the dev team present. So you will not see us there.

Special Edition Demo Release on Steam – April 5
Can’t make it to LGF? Don’t worry — the special edition demo will be available here on Steam right after the event!
Be sure to check it out and let us know what you think!

notes.title: 🚀 Cyber Paradise's NEW DEMO Thriving on Steam Deck At BitSummit! 🚀
notes.content:
We just wrapped up an intense 3-day marathon at BitSummit in Japan, and it was nothing short of legendary! We hooked up a Steam Deck to a monitor and put Cyber Paradise to the ultimate test.

For three epic days, from 10 AM to 5 PM, our booth was swarmed with enthusiastic gamers! The Steam Deck held up like a champ, powering through continuous gameplay without breaking a sweat.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44328944/018a2bbaf543be93a7f0f4bb4e146647b6745662.jpg

Highlights:

 10 AM to 5 PM: Non-stop action (almost!).
 3 Days: Of near-continuous play sessions.
 Steam Deck: Proving Cyber Paradise's NEW DEMO is not just playable but thrives on it!


If you ever doubted the Steam Deck’s capabilities, doubt no more! Cyber Paradise is totally compatible with Steam Deck. Get ready to dive into a world of non-stop cyberpunk action, whether you’re at home or on the go.

PS1: This announcement exists because Steam requires a Steam Event posting to provide Steam Deck compatibility info. We just want to let you know… yeah… Cyber Paradise is totally playable on Steam Deck (with cloud save)!

PS2: It was a blast at BitSummit. Presses came by, we were interviewed and there are now at least 14 pieces of media coverage on Cyber Paradise from multiple countries! We can't be more grateful! Check out the pieces at https://cyberparadise.net/!

PS3: If you missed our previous announcement on the launch of Cyber Paradise's NEW DEMO, here's the launch trailer:
[previewyoutube=zB8lJyHZMOY;full][/previewyoutube]
Play it now!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2431790/Cyber_Paradise/

PS4: As mentioned in the previous announcement, CyberParadise will be part of the #PixElatedFestival starting in 4 days, hosted by Brave At Night 
Visit http://pixelatedfest.com for the complete line-up of games!

notes.title: 🚨Brand-New BitSummit Demo Out NOW🚨
notes.content:
🚨Brand-New BitSummit Demo Out NOW🚨
🔥More Atmospheric, Tighter Storytelling, and Escalating Combats
🌃New Biomes, New Music and Retro Cultural Fusion

New Demo Launch Trailer:

[previewyoutube=zB8lJyHZMOY;full][/previewyoutube]

Play Now
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2431790/Cyber_Paradise/?snr=1_1056_4_creator_curator-tabs&curator_clanid=40274833

More Atmospheric, Tighter Storytelling, and Escalating Combats

After showcasing at multiple festivals and extensive playtesting over the past year, the demo has undergone some major revamps. The original 3-hour demo is now condensed into a 20-30-minute experience of heartfelt stories, escalating battles, and an atmospheric cyberpunk setting, allowing players to quickly grasp the essence of the game. For those craving more lore, the old demo remains hidden in a secret area within the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44328944/a1f837f5b94ae807df6eda588841894d6bf763be.png

New Biomes, New Music and Retro Cultural Fusion

In addition to the original azure harbour biome, the updated version introduces new environments inspired by the devs' hometowns, featuring classic Hong Kong architecture, colonial British buildings, and nostalgic Taiwanese street food. Imagine a sprawling urban landscape with hovering drones, a steampunk industrial atmosphere, the distant clatter of construction machinery, and shadowy, neon-lit alleys. The murmurs of distant crowds enhance the ambience, all set to new music with a moody, atmospheric vibe and subtle electronic beats, creating a striking contrast between the vibrant city life and the cyberpunk setting's gritty undertones.

The team is now collaborating with the notable US pixel artist Blueeyes Norton, who has contributed several pieces of concept art and a new cover for the game. His unique art style inspired the new demo's visuals, which have been carefully adapted to incorporate his distinctive artistic influence.
